competency_fulfillment.rationale: Samples directly show peso bill/coin total-value questions ('total value of 1 ₱50 bill, 1 ₱20 bill...') and 'Write 7694 in words' number-to-words tasks, matching the 'read and write money in words and using currency symbols' wording well.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: variant_registry shows money_peso at 36 combos (4 axes) and number_reading at 2 combos; the 5 samples draw from both DNAs (coin totals and word-form writing), a reasonable illustrative cross-section.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: 'What is the total value of 1 ₱50 bill, 1 ₱20 bill, 1 ₱10 coin, and 1 ₱5 coin?' is under 22 words and a single summation step, appropriate for grade 3 quarter 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: No sample shows the centavo sign or an amount printed with a decimal centavo component, so that specific clause of the competency ('...and the centavo sign') isn't illustrated in this slice.

competency_alignment.rationale: Reading/writing money in both numeral-to-words and coin/bill-counting forms logically builds toward the stated competency without drifting into money-addition content that belongs to a later node.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Observed amounts (80 to 7694) plausibly progress toward the stated ₱10 000 ceiling for this competency.
